data.long_meaning: Ayanit is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Ayana' which means 'Sky'. This name is given to a boy born under the sky or in the sky. In Hindu mythology, Ayanit is the name of a celestial being, a god of the sky or the wind. He is depicted as a young boy, riding a chariot drawn by horses or eagles. The name Ayanit carries the meaning “Born from the sky” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ayanit usually hope their child will grow to embody born from the sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
